long_biography.plain_text:
When Dutch produce-auction consolidation excluded the small Scherpenhuizen wholesaler from a key sales channel, Martin Scherpenhuizen helped organise direct relationships with growers. The response included co-founding the grower sales organisation Vers Direct Nederland and changed how the family company sourced its fruit and vegetables.

Packing capacity, quality checks, transport and distribution gave Scherpenhuizen greater control over the supply chain as it broadened its customer base across Europe. As co-chief executive, Martin has described motivated employees as the company's most important asset, placing staff involvement alongside the logistical discipline required to move perishable produce at scale.
